notes.title: Update 1.5
notes.content:
Hello!

New update introducing a brand-new feature: the easel. Craft paintings with this new workstation to decorate your shop or sell them to make a profit!



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44974071/090c225e793f03a25a57d227df1ba972d5502722.png"]


Changes :
Added a new workstation: the easel.

Paint cans are now considered recyclable waste. (Paint cans you’ve already found will be automatically moved to the Trash category in your inventory. However, those you placed for sale will remain on the ground, it’s up to you whether to sell them or pick them up to recycle.)

New item to find.



Thank you all for following the updates and for all the feedback I’ve received. Feel free to join the Discord to suggest new ideas or report any bugs I may have missed. I read your messages carefully, and I truly hope my game will keep improving over time! ːluvː

notes.title: Update 1.4
notes.content:
Hello! Here’s the new update. This one adds a new area to explore along with a brand-new feature : access cards. New items are now available, as well as new decorations. The update also includes some bug fixes and slight shadow optimizations. I hope you’ll enjoy it!



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44974071/c7c1d97e5778934114c08516a91e5a2a417f7161.png"]


Changes:
Added a new area

New mission

Added decorations to the computer shop

New items

Shadow optimization

Fixed some translations


Access Cards:

Green keycards can be found in filing cabinets across all maps, while orange ones are only found in offices.
They allow you to unlock sealed doors in order to reach high-quality loot.
The cards can be found in the "Tool" category of the inventory and can only be used once.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44974071/8a34e656a498b6e7fe529bd4ed642b0b091ff3f6.png"]



I hope you’ll enjoy this update!
The access card system will be expanded to other maps in future updates.
Thank you for your feedback, and see you soon!

notes.title: Update 0.2.4
notes.content:
Hello! The 0.2.4 update for Storage Looter is finally here! This update introduces a new area to loot: the house! Along with this new location, you’ll find new items and furniture to place in your shop.
[hr][/hr]🏠 New area:
Two new missions are now available to introduce the house, as well as a repeatable mission.

The house features new lootable items, including a brand-new category: home appliances. These are large-sized items that can be sold in your shop.

Currently, only one type of appliance is available, as a test to see if large objects work well in shops.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44974071/fff5ec7867c3da51e405cfb61314ca44d1613990.png"]
[hr][/hr]🛋️ New items and furniture:
New items and furniture have been added.

Since the update that allows you to mark an item as “decorative,” you’ll find more and more decorative items during missions. It’s up to you to decide whether to sell them or keep them for decoration.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44974071/9dbe8f1a90f8383e686875f94c6542a806ee347e.png"]
[hr][/hr]🛠️ Craftable items:
New craftable items are available to make use of materials that were previously useless.

More crafting recipes will be added in future updates.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44974071/7080a7fb60b9a6414b700090c095dfba28e9a69e.png"]
[hr][/hr]📦 Collection system:
You can now track your progress with the collection system.

Use the in-game computer to check which items you’ve looted and which ones you haven’t yet.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44974071/11fefad387b4d89f8695e6afcc8a4486e729961f.png"]
[hr][/hr]🔧 Miscellaneous changes:
Rats can now appear during business missions. (This is a test to make missions feel more dynamic and alive. More animals might be added if the idea is well-received!)

Sweeping the floor during missions now earns you 1 dollar per stain removed.

Fixed lighting in certain missions.

The “New Item” popup will now only appear the first time you pick up a new item.

Placing tank miniatures as decoration will now remove their glass casing so they’re easier to see.
[hr][/hr]
Thanks a lot for all the feedback, it helped me tweak some things and add new features. I hope you enjoy this update! I’m working on making it easier to add new items so I can update the game more frequently.

👉 Don’t forget there’s a Discord server if you encounter any issues, I’ll do my best to fix them! 😄

🎮 Have fun!

notes.title: Update 0.2.1
notes.content:
Hello,

First of all, thank you for your recent feedback. I’ve noted many things to tweak and improve in order to make the game more enjoyable. Your comments are very important to me, they help identify what’s not working in the gameplay and also give me perspective on how to develop the different elements of the game.

I've kept many of the ideas that were recently suggested to me, and I’ll do my best to implement them in the coming days.

In the meantime, here’s a small update that fixes some bugs and introduces tooltips when hovering over an item in the inventory. These tooltips will provide more information about how to use an item or a feature.

Changes:


 Slot machine cost has been reduced, and their rewards increased.
+ Added information bubbles when hovering over items in the inventory.
 NPCs will arrive more quickly when you enter the shop.
 Fixed some furniture items in the inventory that couldn’t be deleted.
 Fixed a few translation errors.


Thanks again for all your feedback and suggestions! I’m really happy to see you’re enjoying the game, and I’ll do everything I can to keep improving it in the days and weeks to come!

notes.title: Update 0.2
notes.content:
General :

Hello everyone! It's finally time to launch version 0.2 of Storage Looter!
A ton of new features for your store are waiting for you, such as new wall and floor customizations, as well as new decorations. But most importantly, you now have the ability to expand your store!

New customization options are also available in the "Decorations" menu on the computer. These allow you to change the name of your store, as well as the color and intensity of the exterior lights.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44974071/059790a4b5288e76a9848205a30a5f9bf5d2b6f5.png

This update was also an opportunity for me to optimize the decoration system, which will allow me to add new items more quickly and with greater creative freedom.

Player movement has been improved, sounds have been added, and navigation within the computer menus has also been enhanced.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44974071/4bce2cf008f63e947e8fcaff7a5ca6848f3ef644.png

I'm planning to give you the freedom to place objects in the street if you'd like to decorate it.
Purely visual, urban-style decorations will start appearing in future updates.

Don't forget there's a Discord server available if you want to report bugs or share suggestions.
I'd be happy to read all your ideas!


New Wall & Floor decorations examples :
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44974071/ec7667e8a40649338010ec5c63a78b6f858579bd.png

New Wall & Floor decorations examples :
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44974071/af3680a614e39611147fbebf72928ff231f9f9ac.png

New casino available right in front of your shop :
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44974071/ea0fe6f051d1c0b42f87c74fcd9d67abafc12eca.png


Easter event :

The Easter event is now live! Collect eggs during your missions and spend them on a new slot machine at the Casino, right across from your store.
This is the first themed event update, my goal is to create one for each holiday to add themed decorations.

Changes :


 + A complete shop overhaul with the ability to expand it
  Improved navigation in the computer menus
  A redesign of the player's store
 + New Wall & Floor decorations
 + New lighting and various customization options
 + Added sound effects when the player moves



In case of a bug:

/!\ With the deployment of this update, it's possible that some objects may be stuck in the ground if your save is from before version 0.2.
No worries! To fix this issue, simply:

 
 Close your store using the computer.
 Go to the menu: Escape → Debug → Delete all items.


All items will automatically be returned to your inventory.
Logically, this shouldn't happen. If you have a save from before version 0.2, all placed items will automatically be removed when the save is loaded.

notes.title: Update planned for Monday
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

Thank you for your initial feedback! A patch will be released Monday evening to fix some issues and improve the game's quality of life. Here’s a preview of the planned fixes and improvements:

- Fixed some translation errors
- Some items couldn’t be picked up in repeatable missions
- Fixed a save issue that could cause the last placed piece of furniture to disappear
- Lowered the volume of crate destruction sounds, which were too loud compared to the rest of the game
- Displayed the "L" key prompt for turning on the flashlight
- Fixed certain achievements not unlocking properly


Thanks again for your feedback! The game will keep improving over time. Feel free to leave a review—it really helps me a lot!
